presets.clear-explainer: Speak in clear, natural English with a calm, confident explanatory tone. Use a moderate pace and brief pauses between ideas. Emphasize key words without sounding theatrical.
presets.warm-story: Speak in warm, conversational English with a gentle storytelling tone. Use a relaxed pace and natural pauses. Keep the delivery sincere and avoid exaggerated character acting.
presets.engaging-hook: Speak in energetic but natural English with curiosity and a confident opening. Use crisp phrasing and purposeful emphasis. Do not shout or rush the words.
